description: This file declares CUDA kernel launching functions related to cumulative operations (cummax, cummin, logcumsumexp, cumsum, cumprod) on tensors within the PyTorch's ATen library. It primarily includes function prototypes and namespace organization, with dependencies on tensor structures.

methods.name: launch_cummax_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel to compute the cumulative maximum of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: launch_cummin_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel to compute the cumulative minimum of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: launch_logcumsumexp_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel to compute the log-cumulative sum of exponentials for a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: launch_cumsum_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel to compute the cumulative sum of a tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: launch_cumprod_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches a CUDA kernel to compute the cumulative product of a tensor along a specified dimension.
